description: Caption a whole folder: run one operation on 1-50 videos in one call, priced together. operation caption = transcribe + burn per item, same output and price as caption_video (5 credits/min); transcribe 1/min; burn 4/min (needs subtitles or transcriptionJobId). One preset for all (an item's own preset or styleOverrides wins). dryRun:true returns the total and starts nothing. Missing media, 402 insufficient_balance or maxCredits reject the whole batch before any charge. Returns id, counts and jobs (paginated: offset/limit); poll get_job per item. For one video use caption_video.

dryRun.description: true = return the total quote only; nothing is charged or started.

items.description: 1-50 items, each {mediaUrl or fileId, name?, language?, preset?, styleOverrides?, faceAvoid?, translateTo? (caption), subtitles?/transcriptionJobId? (burn)}.

faceAvoid.description: true = move captions off faces (samples faces at 2 fps, same price; result.faceAvoid.faceLayout). Shortcut for styleOverrides.faceAvoid.

highlightWords.description: Shortcut: words or phrases to color in every caption (accent/case-insensitive), e.g. ["AwesomeVideo", "gratis"]. Maps to styleOverrides.wordHighlights rule {id:"custom", words, color}. Same price.

styleOverrides.description: Per-call style changes deep-merged onto the preset (same fields as get_catalog {kind:'presets'} style; null removes a field), validated with the renderer schema and bundled fonts. Example {"fontSize":72,"maxWordsPerCaption":2,"wordEntrance":"bounce"}. Same price. No need to manage_preset {action:'create', type:'custom'}. Every field with examples: get_catalog {kind:'styles'}.

maxCredits.description: Cap for the whole batch in credits; refused before any item starts when the total is higher.

operation.description: 'caption' (transcribe + burn per item, same as caption_video), 'transcribe' or 'burn' (existing captions), applied to every item.

preset.description: Preset for every caption or burn item (an item's own preset wins).

name: batch

costCents.description: Total credits (quote on dryRun, charged so far otherwise).

dryRun.description: true: quote only, nothing started or charged.

id.description: Batch id (absent on dryRun). Read progress with get_job id, or GET /v1/batches/{id}?offset=&limit=.

jobs.description: This page of item jobs (index, name, id, status, result files).

page.description: {offset, limit, nextOffset}: nextOffset null on the last page.

status.description: running, succeeded, or failed (some item failed; its credits are refunded).

title: Batch jobs
